evidence_frontier: Exp021 (PNN‑v1‑Exp021) evaluated a 4,278‑parameter w8 compression of Alpha5 on ECG200 and observed 887 aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions out of 1000, exactly 10 fewer than the Alpha5 w16 control (897 correct). This candidate failed the retention gate but defines a clear performance boundary for the w8 compression. No other experiments have tested the w8‑vs‑w16 comparison on a fresh seed set.
analysis: Exp021 demonstrated that w8 compression reduces correct predictions by 10 relative to the w16 control on a single seed configuration. Because the gate was relative (candidate_correct >= control_correct - 10), the result sits exactly at the boundary, leaving open whether this difference is reproducible across independent seeds. A confirmation experiment with a preregistered seed set is required to validate the w8 boundary before any further compression attempts.
hypothesis: When evaluated on five independent preregistered seeds, the w8‑compressed Alpha5 will achieve aggregate correct predictions no more than 10 fewer than the w16 control on ECG200, satisfying the relative gate candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10.

proposal.title: Confirmation of w8 Local‑Width Boundary on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Is the w8 compression performance boundary (≤ 10 fewer correct predictions than w16) reproducible on a fresh set of seeds?
proposal.rationale: Exp021 identified the w8 boundary but used a single seed configuration. Confirming this boundary with independent seeds validates the robustness of the w8 compression limit and informs future size‑reduction strategies for Alpha5.

procedure: For each seed, train the candidate model with local_width = 8 for 50 epochs on the ECG200 training set
For each seed, evaluate both the candidate (w8) and the control (Alpha5 w16) on the ECG200 test set
Record aggregate correct predictions for candidate and control per seed
Accept the experiment if, for each seed, candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10

proposal.success_criteria: For every of the five seeds, the candidate w8 model must achieve aggregate correct predictions that are at most 10 fewer than the w16 control (candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10).
proposal.risks: Potential risk that w8 fails the gate on one or more seeds, leading to a negative result and requiring a redesign of compression strategy. No hardware‑level claims are made; all measurements rely on Q.ANT CPU/software simulation.
